Generated by tools/figures/architecture_readme.py from architecture/item-definition.yaml, safety/hazards/ and requirements/. Concept-stage item definition (status draft): not a baseline. IFs = interfaces it is an
end of; Hazards = hazard records naming it as a subsystem; Reqs = requirements allocated to it.

g.text: Terms: BMS = battery management system · ESC = electronic speed controller (drives a UAV motor) · IF-nnn = interface in the item definition (architecture/item-definition.yaml) · PX4 = PX4
Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-A1-FC = PX4-based flight controller · SUS-A1-NAV = navigation sensors,
camera and telemetry · SUS-A1-PROP = motors, ESCs and propellers · SUS-A1-PWR = UAV battery and power management · SUS-GSE = ground support, maintenance supports, charging and test equipment
· SUS-I1 = integrated mechanized walker and observation UAV · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1 = piloted walker · SUS-M1-CTL = mission, motion and balance
control · SUS-M1-DCK = UAV dock, retention, charging and release · SUS-M1-MAN = manipulation arms and end effectors · SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and controls ·
SUS-M1-PWR = power generation, storage, distribution and thermal control · SUS-M1-PWR-BAT = battery pack, BMS and contactors (alternative B) · SUS-M1-PWR-DIST = protected power distribution
· SUS-M1-PWR-GEN = engine-generator and governor (alternative B) · SUS-M1-PWR-HPU = hydraulic power unit, accumulators and isolation (alternative A) · SUS-M1-SAF = independent safety
monitor, protective stop and isolation · SUS-M1-WLK = chassis, legs, joint actuators and stability sensing · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
